title: Zanthoxylum nitidum-derived active alkaloid nitidine chloride mitigates ulcerative colitis by remodeling gut microbiota and activating SIRT1 to restore intestinal barrier integrity.
authors: Lu, Qiang; Chen, Ruihua; Wei, Shuoshi; Zheng, DanDan; Chen, Haohui; Zhao, Luyou; Li, Cailan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物氯化硝啶通过SIRT1调节肠道屏障和菌群治疗溃疡性结肠炎，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a recurrent inflammatory bowel disorder with rising prevalence and limited efficacy of current treatments. Nitidine chloride (NC), a characteristic bioactive constituent of Zanthoxylum nitidum (Liang-Mian-Zhen), possesses diverse pharmacological properties, including anti-inflammatory, antitumor, and antioxidant activities. Nevertheless, its role in UC and the associated regulatory mechanisms remain incompletely defined. PURPOSE: This study investigated whether NC protects against experimental colitis and clarified its effects on epithelial barrier integrity, gut microbial composition, and SIRT1-associated regulation of endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling. METHODS: Experimental colitis was established using 3% dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-treated mice, while LPS-stimulated Caco-2 cells were used to evaluate epithelial barrier dysfunction in vitro. Disease severity, barrier integrity, and gut microbial alterations were assessed by histological, permeability-related, and 16S rRNA sequencing analyses. Transepithelial electrical resistance (TEER) and FITC-dextran assays were applied to evaluate epithelial permeability. ER stress, TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling, inflammatory mediators, and SIRT1-related mechanisms were examined by Western blot, qRT-PCR, ELISA, molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), pharmacological inhibition with EX-527, and SIRT1 overexpression. RESULTS: NC markedly alleviated DSS-induced colitis, as evidenced by reduced clinical symptoms, attenuated histological injury, and improved intestinal barrier function. NC restored ZO-1, occludin, and mucin 2 (MUC2) expression, improved Alcian blue-positive goblet cell area, and reduced serum DAO and d-lactate levels. Microbiota analysis showed that NC partly corrected DSS-induced gut microbial dysbiosis and reshaped predicted microbial functions. In LPS-stimulated Caco-2 cells, NC improved barrier integrity by increasing TEER, reducing FITC-dextran permeability, and restoring tight junction protein expression. Mechanistically, NC increased SIRT1 expression and suppressed the PERK-eIF2alpha-ATF4-CHOP and TLR4/NF-kappaB pathways both in vivo and in vitro. CETSA further supported target engagement between NC and SIRT1 in Caco-2 cells. Moreover, EX-527 largely abolished the protective effects of NC, whereas SIRT1 overexpression attenuated LPS-induced ER stress and inflammatory signaling. CONCLUSION: NC exerted significant protective effects against experimental UC by alleviating inflammation, preserving epithelial and mucus barrier integrity, and partially restoring gut microbial homeostasis. These effects were associated, at least in part, with SIRT1-mediated suppression of ER stress and TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling. NC may represent a promising natural agent for UC therapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）是一种复发性炎症性肠病，其患病率不断上升，而现有治疗方法的疗效有限。氯化两面针碱（Nitidine chloride, NC）是两面针（Liang-Mian-Zhen）的一种特征性生物活性成分，具有多种药理特性，包括抗炎、抗肿瘤和抗氧化活性。然而，其在UC中的作用及相关调控机制仍未完全明确。目的：本研究探讨NC是否对实验性结肠炎具有保护作用，并阐明其对上皮屏障完整性、肠道微生物组成以及SIRT1相关的内质网（endoplasmic reticulum, ER）应激和TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路的调控效应。方法：采用3%葡聚糖硫酸钠（dextran sulfate sodium, DSS）处理的小鼠建立实验性结肠炎，同时使用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的Caco-2细胞在体外评估上皮屏障功能障碍。通过组织学、通透性相关及16S rRNA测序分析评估疾病严重程度、屏障完整性和肠道微生物变化。应用跨上皮电阻（transepithelial electrical resistance, TEER）和FITC-葡聚糖实验评估上皮通透性。通过Western blot、qRT-PCR、ELISA、分子对接、细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay, CETSA）、EX-527药理学抑制及SIRT1过表达，检测ER应激、TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路、炎症介质及SIRT1相关机制。结果：NC显著缓解了DSS诱导的结肠炎，表现为临床症状减轻、组织学损伤减弱及肠道屏障功能改善。NC恢复了ZO-1、occludin和黏蛋白2（mucin 2, MUC2）的表达，增加了阿尔辛蓝阳性杯状细胞面积，并降低了血清DAO和d-乳酸水平。微生物群分析显示，NC部分纠正了DSS诱导的肠道微生物失调，并重塑了预测的微生物功能。在LPS刺激的Caco-2细胞中，NC通过增加TEER、降低FITC-葡聚糖通透性及恢复紧密连接蛋白表达，改善了屏障完整性。机制上，NC在体内和体外均增加了SIRT1表达，并抑制了PERK-eIF2alpha-ATF4-CHOP和TLR4/NF-kappaB通路。CETSA进一步支持了NC与SIRT1在Caco-2细胞中的靶点结合。此外，EX-527在很大程度上消除了NC的保护作用，而SIRT1过表达则减弱了LPS诱导的ER应激和炎症信号传导。结论：NC通过减轻炎症、维持上皮和黏液屏障完整性以及部分恢复肠道微生物稳态，对实验性UC表现出显著的保护作用。这些效应至少部分与SIRT1介导的ER应激和TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路抑制相关。NC可能成为UC治疗的一种有前景的天然药物。
